gloss: others; the rest; miscellaneous; et cetera

definitions.gloss: others; the rest; miscellaneous; et cetera

examples.japanese: その{他|た}の{質問|しつもん}はありますか。
{本|ほん}やノート、その{他|た}の{文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought books, notebooks, and other stationery.

examples.japanese: アンケートの{選択肢|せんたくし}に「その{他|た}」と{書|か}いてある{欄|らん}に{自由|じゆう}に{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please write freely in the box labeled 'Other' on the survey choices.

examples.japanese: {交通費|こうつうひ}、{食費|しょくひ}、その{他|た}もろもろの{費用|ひよう}がかかった。
examples.english: Transportation costs, food expenses, and various other expenses were incurred.

notes:
A very common expression meaning "others" or "the rest," used to refer to remaining items in a category. Often appears in lists, forms, and menus as a catch-all category.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- その{他|た}の + noun: other (noun), the remaining (noun)
- その{他|た}もろもろ: various other things
- その{他|た}いろいろ: and various others

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- その{他|た}の{費用|ひよう}: other expenses
- その{他|た}の{条件|じょうけん}: other conditions
- その{他|た}の{事項|じこう}: other matters
- その{他|た}{大勢|おおぜい}: the masses, the rest of the crowd

USAGE:
Often written as その{他|た} or simply その{他|ほか} (read as そのほか), which is a near-synonym. The そのた reading is more formal and commonly appears in written documents, forms, and official categories, while そのほか is more conversational.
